claims: Assess and manage acute kidney injury with creatinine 5.1 mg/dL and BUN 57 mg/dL, including strict intake/output monitoring and review of nephrotoxic medications.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (7.8 g/dL / 24.2%) and evaluate for transfusion need or ongoing blood loss.
Monitor serum phenytoin level (1.5 ug/mL, subtherapeutic) and continue seizure prophylaxis with phenytoin per active order.
Monitor acid-base status with bicarbonate 17 mEq/L and anion gap 15 mEq/L; reassess electrolytes and renal function.
Continue hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and maintain blood pressure within ordered alarm parameters.
Perform fall precautions given documented fall history and bed rest status.
Perform skin assessment and pressure injury prevention for documented impaired skin area (1.5 cm x 1 cm) and Braden score indicating risk.
Continue pain management with active analgesics (morphine, oxycodone, acetaminophen) and reassess pain level.
Continue bowel regimen with docusate, bisacodyl, and senna as ordered.
Continue antimicrobial therapy with cefazolin as ordered.
